text: The major is designed to train professionals with basic knowledge of life science, electronic technology, computer technology and information science, as well as the research capacity in the area of medical and engineering technology. Graduates are qualified for such positions as research, development, teaching and management in biomedical engineering, medical equipment and other areas of electronic technology, computer technology, and information industry. The major is to train expertise of medical information processing and medical intelligent instrumentation development professional training information with the background of information technology, who know biology, medicine and engineering information. It pays much attention to theory and experiments, conducting a number of medical cooperation with companies so that students have a solid theoretical foundation, with strong experimental skills and pioneering and innovative spirit.
